              This is a basic TOEIC Listening & Reading preparation course. Students will learn the basics of the test structure as well as test-taking and study strategies through exercises and assignments.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              - This course is a three-week intensive summer session.
- Students are required to take the TOEIC IP test at the beginning and the end of the course.
- Students are required to set their goal, make a plan to achieve the goal, and work hard.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Tactics for the TOEIC Test (R) Listening & Reading Test Introductory Course Student Book with Online Skills Practice, Oxford University Press (textbook)
TOEIC TEST Derutan Tokkyu Gin no Phrase (Silver Phrases), Asahi Shimbun Publications (reference book)
